    UsmSecurity.passwordToKey(UsmSecurity.AuthProtocol authProtocol, String password)
    Derives the user key Ku from password using the RFC 3414 §A.2 KDF: the passphrase bytes (UTF-8) are repeated to fill a stream of exactly 1048576 bytes which is hashed once with the protocol digest.
    static byte[]
    UsmSecurity.passwordToLocalizedKey(UsmSecurity.AuthProtocol authProtocol, String password, byte[] engineId)
    Convenience that chains UsmSecurity.passwordToKey(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.UsmSecurity.AuthProtocol, java.lang.String) and UsmSecurity.localizeKey(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.UsmSecurity.AuthProtocol, byte[], byte[]): derive Ku from the passphrase and localize it to engineId in one call.
